about: Curated facts that text mining misses. Every entry is marked origin=curated in the output. Verify numbers with `gh issue view N -R boykopovar/AnyPS5` before adding. See AGENTS.md.

blockers.title: Packed pixel ancillary word read whole after its VGPR is reused

fix_prs.note: retire a depth surface once another writer covers its memory

related_prs.note: merged: same idea for sampled views

blockers.title: Windows: direct memory mapped one 16 KiB view at a time

fix_prs.note: maps direct memory as write-watched private pages; 2.4 GB in about 2.3 s instead of minutes

blockers.next: Review and merge #2054. Without it one sceKernelMapDirectMemory of 64-155 MiB takes 10-120 s and Unreal's RenderThread watchdog fires.
blockers.notes: Stall, no error line. WindowsMappings::Map makes one MapViewOfFile3 per 16 KiB page.
